Title: Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server Supports the tdigest Extension

Body.Content:
With the general availability of the tdigest extension in Azure Database for PostgreSQL, you can nowperform accurate quantile estimation for numeric data, making it easier to analyze percentiles and distributions at scale. 

 

Learn more.
